mapper.sql: analysis_id, plan_id, analysis_no, analysis_type, analysis_period, analysis_content, analysis_result, quality_score, is_valid, valid_until, template_id, analysis_data, recommendations, value_assessment, org_id, create_user, create_time, update_user, update_time, is_deleted
mapper.select: SELECT FROM fund_plan_analysis WHERE analysis_no = #{analysisNo} AND is_deleted = 0
SELECT FROM fund_plan_analysis WHERE plan_id = #{planId} AND is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY create_time DESC
SELECT FROM fund_plan_analysis WHERE analysis_type = #{analysisType} AND org_id = #{orgId} AND is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY create_time DESC
SELECT FROM fund_plan_analysis WHERE is_valid = 1 AND org_id = #{orgId} AND is_deleted = 0 AND (valid_until IS NULL OR valid_until > NOW()) ORDER BY quality_score DESC, create_time DESC
SELECT FROM fund_plan_analysis WHERE quality_score >= #{minQualityScore} AND org_id = #{orgId} AND is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY quality_score DESC, create_time DESC
SELECT FROM fund_plan_analysis WHERE org_id = #{orgId} AND is_deleted = 0 AND create_time >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY) ORDER BY create_time DESC
SELECT analysis_type, COUNT(*) as count FROM fund_plan_analysis WHERE org_id = #{orgId} AND is_deleted = 0 GROUP BY analysis_type

SELECT analysis_type, COUNT(*) as analysisCount, COALESCE(AVG(quality_score), 0) as avgQualityScore, COALESCE(MIN(quality_score), 0) as minQualityScore, COALESCE(MAX(quality_score), 0) as maxQualityScore, COUNT(CASE WHEN quality_score >= 90 THEN 1 END) as excellentCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN quality_score >= 80 THEN 1 END) as goodCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN quality_score >= 70 THEN 1 END) as fairCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN quality_score < 70 THEN 1 END) as poorCount FROM fund_plan_analysis WHERE org_id = #{orgId} AND is_deleted = 0 GROUP BY analysis_type ORDER BY avgQualityScore DESC

SELECT analysis_type, COUNT(*) as totalCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN is_valid = 1 THEN 1 END) as validCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN template_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 END) as templateBasedCount, ROUND(COUNT(CASE WHEN is_valid = 1 THEN 1 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*), 2) as validRate, ROUND(COUNT(CASE WHEN template_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*), 2) as templateUsageRate FROM fund_plan_analysis WHERE org_id = #{orgId} AND is_deleted = 0 GROUP BY analysis_type ORDER BY totalCount DESC

SELECT t.template_no, t.template_name, COUNT(a.analysis_id) as usageCount, COALESCE(AVG(a.quality_score), 0) as avgQualityScore, COUNT(CASE WHEN a.is_valid = 1 THEN 1 END) as validCount, MAX(a.create_time) as lastUsedTime FROM fund_plan_template t LEFT JOIN fund_plan_analysis a ON t.template_id = a.template_id AND a.is_deleted = 0 WHERE t.org_id = #{orgId} AND t.is_deleted = 0 GROUP BY t.template_id, t.template_no, t.template_name HAVING usageCount > 0 ORDER BY usageCount DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE fund_plan_analysis SET quality_score = #{qualityScore}, update_user = #{updateUser}, update_time = NOW() WHERE analysis_id = #{analysisId} AND is_deleted = 0
UPDATE fund_plan_analysis SET is_valid = #{isValid}, valid_until = #{validUntil}, update_user = #{updateUser}, update_time = NOW() WHERE analysis_id = #{analysisId} AND is_deleted = 0
UPDATE fund_plan_analysis SET value_assessment = #{valueAssessment}, update_user = #{updateUser}, update_time = NOW() WHERE analysis_id = #{analysisId} AND is_deleted = 0

UPDATE fund_plan_analysis SET quality_score = CASE WHEN analysis_content IS NOT NULL AND LENGTH(analysis_content) > 1000 AND analysis_result IS NOT NULL AND LENGTH(analysis_result) > 500 AND recommendations IS NOT NULL AND LENGTH(recommendations) > 200 THEN 95 WHEN analysis_content IS NOT NULL AND LENGTH(analysis_content) > 500 AND analysis_result IS NOT NULL AND LENGTH(analysis_result) > 200 THEN 85 WHEN analysis_content IS NOT NULL AND LENGTH(analysis_content) > 200 AND analysis_result IS NOT NULL THEN 75 WHEN analysis_content IS NOT NULL AND analysis_result IS NOT NULL THEN 65 ELSE 50 END, update_time = NOW() WHERE analysis_id = #{analysisId} AND quality_score IS NULL AND is_deleted = 0

UPDATE fund_plan_analysis SET value_assessment = CASE WHEN quality_score >= 90 AND is_valid = 1 THEN 'HIGH' WHEN quality_score >= 80 AND is_valid = 1 THEN 'MEDIUM' WHEN quality_score >= 70 THEN 'MEDIUM' ELSE 'LOW' END, update_time = NOW() WHERE analysis_id = #{analysisId} AND value_assessment IS NULL AND is_deleted = 0

UPDATE fund_plan_analysis SET valid_until = CASE WHEN analysis_type = 'VARIANCE' THEN DATE_ADD(create_time, INTERVAL 3 MONTH) WHEN analysis_type = 'TREND' THEN DATE_ADD(create_time, INTERVAL 6 MONTH) WHEN analysis_type = 'FORECAST' THEN DATE_ADD(create_time, INTERVAL 1 YEAR) WHEN analysis_type = 'RISK' THEN DATE_ADD(create_time, INTERVAL 3 MONTH) WHEN analysis_type = 'PERFORMANCE' THEN DATE_ADD(create_time, INTERVAL 6 MONTH) ELSE DATE_ADD(create_time, INTERVAL 3 MONTH) END, update_time = NOW() WHERE analysis_id = #{analysisId} AND valid_until IS NULL AND is_deleted = 0
mapper.select: SELECT FROM fund_plan_analysis WHERE org_id = #{orgId} AND is_deleted = 0 AND is_valid = 1 AND valid_until IS NOT NULL AND valid_until < NOW() ORDER BY valid_until ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE fund_plan_analysis SET is_valid = 0, update_time = NOW() WHERE org_id = #{orgId} AND is_deleted = 0 AND is_valid = 1 AND valid_until IS NOT NULL AND valid_until < NOW()
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO fund_plan_analysis ( plan_id, analysis_no, analysis_type, analysis_period, analysis_content, template_id, org_id, create_user, create_time, is_deleted ) SELECT #{planId}, CONCAT('ANALYSIS_', DATE_FORMAT(NOW(), '%Y%m%d%H%i%s'), '_', LPAD(#{planId}, 6, '0')), #{analysisType}, #{analysisPeriod}, template_content, template_id, org_id, #{createUser}, NOW(), 0 FROM fund_plan_template WHERE template_id = #{templateId} AND is_deleted = 0
